notes: Bundle generation only: existing live logger Definitions and stored events are not replaced by this build.
CDDL groups implement base composition. Each compiled RX is one flattened Definition.
Only occurrence time is stored. Timestamp unit is milliseconds; duration remains microseconds for this draft, matching existing storage. Neither is converted implicitly in numeric query predicates.
Absent duration means unknown or not applicable, not zero. Operation start/end conventions require an explicit transform and are not guessed.
Internal @ fields remain distinct from ordinary user fields named id, time, duration, or fields. Metadata labels never change binding identity.
Open-map CDDL generates the internal @fields carrier. No separate explicit @fields authoring member is needed.
Metadata value lists are advisory and incomplete, never encoding dictionaries or validity restrictions.
Mappings bind exact source and target RX identities. Resource-scoped ingress transforms execute only explicitly configured casts.
Service and resource taxonomy are supplied by the enclosing resource and are not repeated on every log.
No ObservedTimestamp, duplicate status label, full event UUID, or trace/span reinterpretation is added.
request_size, response_size and message_id retain qualifiers because request versus response and message versus event identity are not implied by the category.
Provider RX files describe single log records, not OTLP export envelopes. Datadog timestamp profile uses epoch milliseconds.
Application-specific fields in job, task, workflow and security profiles are extensions, not claimed standard OpenTelemetry fields.
